remaining_limits: Archive-prefix availability is a source-time proxy, not certified original client receipt or individual sample time.
Lap accuracy, pit and status fields retain the original recorded-as-available convention; source revisions and delivery latency are not reconstructed.
Averaged raw channel codes do not establish fuel, power, energy, brake pressure or verified wing-open duration.
The historical selection dates were previously exposed; event bootstrap intervals do not correct all earlier adaptive research selection.
Historical source preparation, full real-prefix invariance, model fitting, baseline-metric reproduction and candidate scoring have not been performed by this reviewer in this component review.
This receipt does not authorize promotion or substitute for the complete source/specification/data lock and independent runner review.

resolved_findings.finding: Matched-cohort equality alone could not detect deletion of unmatched issuances.
resolved_findings.resolution: expected_issuances is mandatory and independently fixes every original key plus base feature and anchor value. Regression tests remove one or all unmatched rows, add a row and poison unmatched features.

resolved_findings.finding: Relative gain is undefined when a reference has exactly zero mean absolute error.
resolved_findings.resolution: The comparison retains finite absolute differences and intervals, emits null relative_reduction and fails the relative-gain gate. Existing positive-reference mathematics is unchanged.

resolved_findings.finding: The initial telemetry mean could overflow for repeated maximum-finite values or underflow constant subnormal inputs.
resolved_findings.resolution: The feature owner changed the mean to maximum-scaled summation before final source locking. The final suite includes twelve extreme-value regressions; the revised helper was independently read.

reviewer_scope.acquisition: Previously reviewed separately; no acquisition checks or network requests repeated for this receipt.
reviewer_scope.features_and_data: Independent read-only scientific source review and independent test replay.
reviewer_scope.models_and_evaluator: Implementation owner; mathematical and synthetic verification, not an independent author review.

scientific_checks: Atomic physical packets enter only when cumulative-maximum archive availability is strictly before the lag-adjusted exact integer-nanosecond cutoff. Source UTC does not determine feature availability.
Driver windows are lower-inclusive and upper-exclusive at 30, 90 and 180 seconds; future packet payloads are not decoded before admission. Regressing packet times cannot be backdated.
Valid entries are aggregated within each packet before equal packet averaging. Population speed dispersion uses packet means. Presence, validity and joint throttle/brake support remain separate.

The 90-column layout contains exactly 27 content and 63 quality coordinates. The support gate uses six packets, 24-second span and at most five-second newest age in the 30-second window, without requiring all channels.
Missing streams produce explicit unavailable support and exact base fallback; downloaded corruption is a blocking validation result, not a reason to remove rows or relabel the source unavailable.
Original 80 features, naive anchors and issuance identities remain unchanged. Decimal CSV clock text is converted exactly to nanoseconds while preserving the original float-key representation.

All three 2022 fits use the same complete matched population and original event weights N/(E*n_event). Both augmented fits include unsupported training rows. The control zeros content at training and inference while retaining the same feature layout.

The original absolute-error HGB configuration, residual target clipping at five seconds and prediction correction clipping at three seconds are reused. Unsupported inference assigns the exact base bits; zero-second sensitivity reuses the two-second coefficients.

Evaluation requires both an independent complete original issuance inventory and the original matched target population. It rejects removal or addition of unmatched issuances and changes to their original anchors/features.

Selection checks all 22 events, the expected 2022-only base selection MAE, both strong references, one-percent improvement, negative event/block-three interval endpoints and all negative leave-one-event-out means; zero-second sensitivity must improve both corresponding references.

Bootstrap calls reuse the original seed 20260907, 20000 event resamples and subsequent 20000 circular three-event block resamples. Unmatched outcomes receive forecasts and coverage accounting but no invented numeric target loss.
